Abans Financial Services Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.
voiceSummary: Abans Financial Services Limited announced that Mr. Chintan Natwarlal Mehta, DIN 10375218, resigned as Whole-Time Director and Chief Executive Officer with immediate effect on November 11, 2026. He confirmed no material reasons for his resignation. The Board appointed Mr. Mayank Mahesh Mundhra, DIN 12015417, as Additional Director and Whole-Time Director, effective November 11, 2026. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval at the next general meeting or within three months. The company also disclosed plans to incorporate a subsidiary in Hong Kong for bullion and securities trading. The trading window for designated persons remains closed for 48 hours from the announcement.

attchmntText: Abans Financial Services Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Abans Financial Services Limited approved its Unaudited Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 11, 2026. The Board approved the results following the Audit Committee's recommendation. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a profit after tax of 14.32 Crores, compared to a loss of 2.48 Crores in the same period last year. Revenue from operations stood at 15.30 Crores. Basic earnings per share were 2.82. The trading window for dealing in the company's securities remains closed until 48 hours from the announcement date. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review report on the financial results.
